name: Anton
source:
Florien's older brother and the captain of Amarine's knights, Anton is dependable and dutiful to the point of accidentally being feared by others. Under his stoic face is a gentle and slightly awkward man who's just too used to working. He's popular with his subordinates and animals.

He's quite handsome, but doesn't believe himself to be. Once, he was invited to a wedding and the bride attempted to run away with him once she saw his face, to his chagrin. He doesn't seem to have interest in romance, but perhaps that's just because he's already loyal to someone.

Anton doesn't approve of Ciel running away from home, but doesn't like the way Johannes tries to shelter her either. He decides to help Ciel along on her journey as one of her guards, defying his lord.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/2819473.anton]official bio[/url]]
